text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O defeats Oguri Cap and the 
rest. The world calls it a monumental 
upset.

However, she was far from satisfied. To 
become Maruzensky's rival, she still 
needed to sharpen her own abilities.

That overwhelming fighting spirit and 
presence, and above all, those eyes like a 
starving wolf's. —Maruzensky found herself 
captivated.

And so, the two made a promise. Tokyo. 
Turf 2400m. The only G1 race sharing the 
same conditions as the Nippon Derby. Next 
year... they would compete in the Japan 
Cup one year from now.

Sakura Chiyono O burns with determination 
to make her acknowledge her as a true 
rival when that day comes. Her next goal 
for that sake is—
Target race changed to Yasuda Kinen.

Set sights on the Yasuda Kinen. All to 
build up speed that won't lose to the 
"Supercar"—!
Target race changed to Takarazuka Kinen.

She set her sights on the Takarazuka 
Kinen. In order to hone her competitive 
instincts by facing even stronger 
opponents—!
